title: Internal selective attention is delayed by competition between endogenous and exogenous factors
description: This dataset contains preprocessed EEG data from a study of internal selective attention, examining how competition between endogenous and exogenous factors delays the deployment of attention to internal (working memory) representations. Data are provided in BIDS format as .set files with accompanying behavioral summary files for alignment with the EEG.
methods_description: EEG data were collected and preprocessed, with results provided in BIDS-compliant .set format. Behavioral summary data (.mat files) are included for alignment with EEG recordings to enable integrated analysis of neural and behavioral measures.
